How it works

Export only the videos you need.

  1. 01

    Open a video, public channel, or public playlist

    The extension puts the relevant control directly into YouTube.

  2. 02

    Choose the available track and settings

    Set format, timestamps, metadata, and—when exporting in bulk—title and publication-period filters.

  3. 03

    Download one file or a focused ZIP

    Videos without usable captions are skipped so available files can still be saved.

What availability means

The extension downloads only caption tracks YouTube makes available for each public video. It does not transcribe audio. A bulk result can be partial when some videos have no usable captions; available files are still packaged together.
